title.zh: ⚡️Starknet考虑转为L1以自主推进量子安全升级，最快2027年实现相关升级
title.en: ⚡️Starknet考虑转为L1以自主推进量子安全升级，最快2027年实现相关升级

current_state.zh: Starknet 关于是否研究转为独立后量子 L1 的七天非约束性 STRK 持有人投票仍在进行，当前支持率约 99.95%，投票将于 10 月 22 日结束，最终结果尚未公布；该投票不授权实际迁移。
current_state.en: Starknet's seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum L1 remains open, currently at about 99.95% support, with voting set to close on Oct. 22 and final results not yet published; the vote does not authorize an actual transition.

updates.what_changed_zh: StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson表示，Starknet正在权衡包括转为L1在内的多种选项，以便能够独立推动其后量子安全迁移，升级最早可能在2027年到来。
updates.what_changed_en: StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson said Starknet is weighing options including converting to an L1 so it can independently drive its post-quantum security migration, with upgrades potentially arriving as early as 2027.

updates.title_zh: Starknet就因量子风险可能退出以太坊L2开启投票
updates.title_en: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
updates.what_changed_zh: Starknet已开启为期七天的STRK持有人非约束性投票，询问是否研究成为独立的后量子Layer-1以摆脱对以太坊量子安全升级时间表的依赖；投票于10月22日结束，结果公布；Yes仅支持进一步研究，不授权迁移，也无L1时间表。
updates.what_changed_en: Starknet opened a seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum layer-1 to reduce dependence on Ethereum's quantum-security upgrade timeline; voting closes Oct. 22, results will be published, and a Yes vote only supports further research without authorizing a transition or setting an L1 timetable.
updates.current_state_zh: Starknet正在就研究转为独立后量子L1进行七天非约束性STRK持有人投票，投票于10月22日结束，结果尚未公布；该投票不授权实际迁移，后续仍需进一步治理提案和投票。
updates.current_state_en: Starknet is holding a seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on researching an independent post-quantum L1, closing Oct. 22 with results not yet published; the vote does not authorize an actual transition and further governance proposals would be required.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Starknet has opened a seven-day, non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum layer-1 chain to avoid dependence on Ethereum's quantum-security upgrade schedule.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Starknet has opened a seven-day, non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum layer-1 chain to avoid dependence on Ethereum's quantum-security upgrade schedule.

updates.title_zh: 【Starknet 是否应继续转型为 L1 的研究提案支持率目前为 99.95%】
updates.title_en: 【Starknet 是否应继续转型为 L1 的研究提案支持率目前为 99.95%】
updates.what_changed_zh: Snapshot 投票页面显示，该研究提案当前支持率约为 99.95%，赞成票超过 3.45 亿，反对票约 15.77 万，投票仍将于 10 月 22 日结束。
updates.what_changed_en: The Snapshot vote page shows the research proposal currently at about 99.95% support, with over 345 million votes in favor versus roughly 158,000 against, and voting still set to close on Oct. 22.
updates.current_state_zh: Starknet 关于是否研究转为独立后量子 L1 的七天非约束性 STRK 持有人投票仍在进行，当前支持率约 99.95%，投票将于 10 月 22 日结束，最终结果尚未公布；该投票不授权实际迁移。
updates.current_state_en: Starknet's seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum L1 remains open, currently at about 99.95% support, with voting set to close on Oct. 22 and final results not yet published; the vote does not authorize an actual transition.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Starknet's Snapshot research proposal on whether the network should continue transitioning into an L1 is passing with 99.95% support (over 345 million votes in favor versus roughly 158,000 against), with voting set to close on October 22.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Starknet's Snapshot research proposal on whether the network should continue transitioning into an L1 is passing with 99.95% support (over 345 million votes in favor versus roughly 158,000 against), with voting set to close on October 22.
updates.background_zh: Starknet 由 StarkWare 开发，是一条以太坊 ZK rollup，近期一直在评估从二层转为独立一层。联合创始人兼 CEO Eli Ben-Sasson 提到，此举是为了掌控自身安全迁移的时间表，并为量子计算和 AI 相关威胁做准备，同时提出了到 2027 年实现抗量子能力的路径。
updates.background_en: Starknet, built by StarkWare, is an Ethereum ZK-rollup that has been weighing a shift from layer 2 to independent layer 1 status. Co-founder and CEO Eli Ben-Sasson cited control over the network's own security migration timeline and preparation for quantum computing and AI-related threats, with a stated path to quantum resistance by 2027.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次投票目前并不改变跨链桥、托管或结算机制，其传导路径主要通过围绕 STRK 代币的治理情绪，以及若 L1 方向推进、市场如何重新定价 Starknet 与以太坊之间的安全与结算关系。
updates.market_impact_en: The vote does not change bridging, custody or settlement mechanics today; its transmission path runs through governance sentiment around the STRK token and how the market prices Starknet's security and settlement relationship with Ethereum if the L1 direction advances.
